description.value: A Walmart Supercenter (Store 3188) located in Langford, BC, on the outskirts of Greater Victoria. As a full-format Supercenter, it carries a broad grocery section alongside general merchandise including clothing, electronics, and household goods. For touring cyclists passing through the Westshore corridor, it offers one-stop resupply potential for food, basic gear, and sundries.
